negative_controls.failure_mode: A trusted GitHub compare API exception permits traversal in repository path segments.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat any path matching /repos/<token>/<token>/compare/<SHA>...<SHA> as safe even when token is a dot or contains two dots.
negative_controls.procedure: Run test_trusted_github_api_allows_exact_sha_compare_but_never_traversal at authenticated material SHA; compare mutation negative log from d306 material.
negative_controls.expected: Canonical owner/repository plus immutable SHA compare succeeds. Dot, double-dot, encoded or extra path segments cannot reach subprocess.run.
negative_controls.observed: All six newly added namespace cases rejected without gh subprocess; original d306 implementation accepted four representative invalid cases; exact material 61 pytest cases PASS.

risk_surfaces.reason: Binding of issue, base, HEAD and merge preview in package and certificate is checked by fail-closed parsers.
Bootstrap documentation must not claim production trust or Stage B activation by an unmerged PR.
Optional provenance and recognized remediation artefacts must remain authenticated without false refusal.
Remediation mode controls the mandatory critical-certificate artifact inventory.
